evaluation_protocol.selection_split: val (validation metrics: mAP50, mAP50-95, per-class F1)
evaluation_protocol.final_evaluation_split: test (held-out; run ONLY once on chosen best model)
evaluation_protocol.guarded_class: peeling_paint_or_plaster (must maintain or improve baseline metrics)

exp_a_preserve.name: Experiment A: Preserve Baseline Annotations (Control)
exp_a_preserve.strategy: Retain all original 24 annotations as-is, including the 11 UNCERTAIN annotations in training.
exp_a_preserve.notes: Direct controlled replication under seed=42 for benchmarking Strategy B and C.

exp_b_pruned.name: Experiment B: Conservative Sample Pruning
exp_b_pruned.strategy: Exclude the 9 affected training images containing UNCERTAIN annotations from the training split only.
exp_b_pruned.notes: Tests whether eliminating noisy, 50%-area bounding boxes improves crack precision and eliminates false alarms.

exp_c_segmented.name: Experiment C: Mask-Guided Segment Decomposition
exp_c_segmented.strategy: Replace oversized single diagonal bounding envelopes with tight, valid sub-boxes derived from the ground truth crack masks.
exp_c_segmented.notes: Keeps all images while reducing average bounding box area from 50.2% to 18.0%, eliminating 60%+ background area.

safeguards: ai/models/best.pt and ai/models/home_best.pt are protected and will never be overwritten.
Original dataset partition at /content/visionguard_home_dataset is completely untouched.
Validation and test splits are identical and read-only across all experiments.
peeling_paint_or_plaster annotations are completely untouched in all splits.
No training execution will be launched until explicit user approval is granted.
